about: One table of the vehicles' sizes and the lanes' width, read by the simulation (tools/sim/demand.py, gtfs.py, run.py) and the client (src/world/traffic.js TYPES, src/shared/roadway.js corridorOf). length and width: the drawn bodies' (fleet.js), so that SUMO spaces its cars as they are drawn. The types in the order the runs number them.
